name: Cha-ching
description: Donation register that records PayPal IPN payments and exposes JSON/RSS/graph feeds.
project_description:
Cha-ching is a donation register. It records instant payment notification (IPN) data received from PayPal, and makes the metadata (payment amount and date) available via JSON and RSS feeds for display and graphing purposes.

 Cha-ching was originally created for Noisebridge , a hackerspace in San Francisco, California.

 Additional features will be added in the future. You can support development by contributing or sponsoring .
